name: Timee, Inc.
summary: Timee, Inc. plans, develops, and operates a part-time job platform in Japan. The company offers Timee, a part-time job matching service between clients and workers; Timee Career Plus, is a full-time employee recruitment service for registered workers. It also provides project support services to local governments and organizations. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
